BeforeAgent.name: harness-resume
BeforeAgent.command: EH=$(command -v epic-harness 2>/dev/null || for p in /usr/local/bin/epic-harness ~/.cargo/bin/epic-harness; do if [ -x "$p" ]; then echo "$p"; break; fi; done); test -n "$EH" && "$EH" resume || echo '[harness] epic-harness not found'
BeforeAgent.description: Restore session snapshot, load project memory and evolved skills
